nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Generate multiple ecommerce scene variants from a product image, optional segmentation, and prompt guidance.

imageOutputHeight.description: Desired output height in pixels, from 32 to 2048.

imageOutputWidth.description: Desired output width in pixels, from 32 to 2048.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4.

prompt.description: Scene generation prompt, up to 600 characters.

strength.description: Variation strength from 0.1 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

name: nexscope_product_scene_variations
title: Product Scene Variations API
